notes:
Account background: Arcadia runs national rail signaling contact centers (incident response + operator support). Heavy regulatory constraints — must be on-prem/air-gapped for signal control interactions. Primary pain: agents overloaded during cascade incidents; tickets pile up, post-incident reports delayed 24-72h. They want automated summarization + tool-calling to accelerate fixes and reduce human error.

Customer quotes / wants:
- "We cannot have an outbound model call home. No internet egress from signal LAN."
- "Need guarantees during 10x surge windows — critical lines at risk."

Technical requirements summary:
- Full air-gapped/private deployment; installable package for locked-down data center.
- FIPS-compliant crypto + HSM support for key material; integration with on-prem KMS.
- SSO/SAML + SCIM for agent accounts; RBAC integration with internal IAM.
- Audit logging retention 7 years for incident trails.
- Model ingress via physically-seeded media + signed artifact verification.
- Offline update process; on-prem model registry, ability to pin versions and roll back.
- Latency SLO: sub-200ms token latency for agent-assist primaries (95p) under normal loads, graceful degradation to queued/batched responses under 10x spike.
- Throughput: baseline ~500 concurrent agents, peak design target 5,000 concurrent during major incidents (burst mode).

POC scope proposed:
- 6-week POC in lab VLAN: integrate with their CTI + ticketing (Jira-like internal system), run simulated incident surge, measure latency/cost and accuracy on summarization tasks.
- Deliverables: integration guide, performance baseline, security attestation, rollback playbook.

Commercial notes:
- Procurement expects enterprise contract; looking at 3yr term with optional dedicated capacity ring-fenced. Budget indicated $500k–$2M ARR depending on SLA and on-prem coupling.
